title: Public Law
description: Legal advice on dealings with the Portuguese State, public authorities and other public bodies.
keywords: Administrative procedures and decisions Dealings with public bodies and concession holders Public procurement and public contracts Licensing and urban planning Administrative appeals and court proceedings Enforcement of administrative judgments and claims against the State

title: Administrative Law
description: Administrative procedures, licensing and challenges to decisions made by public authorities in Portugal.
keywords: Applications and responses to official notices Licences, authorisations and approvals Refusals, revocations and administrative penalties Challenges to administrative decisions Decisions by concession holders and independent bodies Enforcement of administrative court judgments

title: Public Procurement
description: Advice on public tenders, bids, exclusion and award decisions, and the performance of public contracts.
keywords: Review of tender documents and specifications Requirements for applications and bids Requests for clarification and communications Exclusion and award decisions Pre-contractual litigation Public contract performance and disputes

title: Corporate and Commercial Law
description: Companies, shareholders and commercial contracts supporting business activity in Portugal.
keywords: Company formation and reorganisation Transfers of shares and changes in ownership Articles of association and shareholders’ agreements Corporate resolutions and governance Commercial contracts Prevention and resolution of shareholder disputes

title: Employment and Labour Law
description: Employment contracts, workplace relations, disciplinary procedures and termination of employment.
keywords: Employment contracts and recruitment Employer and employee rights and duties Changes to employment terms Disciplinary procedures and sanctions Dismissal, settlement agreements and other forms of termination Employment disputes

title: Criminal Law
description: Criminal defence and assistance to victims, from the initial investigation through to trial.
keywords: Criminal complaints and reports Legal assistance during questioning Advice on formal suspect status Pre-trial restrictions and challenges Investigation, judicial examination and trial Criminal defence and assistance to victims

title: Debt Recovery and Enforcement
description: Out-of-court and judicial recovery of consumer and mortgage debt. Ongoing management of high-volume case portfolios.
keywords: Out-of-court and judicial debt recovery Consumer and mortgage debt Negotiation and payment agreements Monitoring agreements and responding to default Court claims and enforcement proceedings High-volume case management and client reporting

title: Property, Real Estate and Urban Planning
description: Property transactions, investment, licensing and protection of assets in Portugal.
keywords: Property purchases, sales and preliminary contracts Leases and property use Legal due diligence and document review Title, registration and regularisation Licensing and urban planning Investment and ownership structures

title: Civil Law
description: Contracts, property, leases, condominium disputes and civil liability in Portugal.
keywords: Drafting and review of contracts Breach of contract and contractual liability Ownership, possession and protection of assets Leases and landlord-tenant relations Condominium and neighbour disputes Civil liability and compensation claims

title: Family Law
description: Divorce, parental responsibilities, maintenance and financial matters arising from family relationships.
keywords: Divorce and separation Parental responsibility arrangements Changes to parenting arrangements Child maintenance Unmarried partnerships Financial and property matters following separation

title: Succession and Inheritance
description: Wills, inheritance, division of estates and planning for the transfer of assets.
keywords: Wills and succession planning Formal identification of heirs Acceptance or renunciation of inheritance Identification of estate assets and rights Division of estates and inheritance shares Registration and transfer of inherited assets

title: Litigation and Arbitration
description: Dispute prevention and resolution, negotiation and representation in court and arbitration proceedings.
keywords: Assessment before proceedings Negotiation and settlements Court and arbitration proceedings Breach of contract Civil liability and compensation claims Enforcement and debt recovery

title: Document Certification and Formalities
description: Signature certification, document authentication, certified copies and preparation of legal documents.
keywords: Signature certification Authentication of private documents Certified copies Powers of attorney Certification of translations Spousal consent and travel authorisations for minors

title: Immigration and Nationality
description: Residence, visas, nationality and legal advice for foreign nationals in Portugal.
keywords: Assessment of residence options Preparation of application documents D2 and D7 residence visas Residence permits for investment activity Family reunification Nationality matters and dealings with public authorities

title: Residence in Portugal
description: Legal preparation for residence and relocation to Portugal for foreign nationals and their families.
keywords: Assessment of residence options D2 and D7 visas Residence through eligible investment Family reunification Documents, legalisation and translations Coordination with housing and business matters

title: D2 Visa in Portugal
description: Assistance for entrepreneurs and self-employed professionals preparing a Portuguese residence visa application.
keywords: Review of the business or professional project Application document preparation Coordination with the business plan Company formation where appropriate Tax number, banking and accommodation Coordination with residence and family matters

title: D7 Visa in Portugal
description: Assistance for pensioners and applicants with independent income preparing to reside in Portugal.
keywords: Assessment of income and financial means Organisation of financial evidence Application document preparation Tax number, banking and accommodation Foreign documents and legalisation Coordination with residence and family reunification

title: Golden Visa and Investment Residence
description: Legal assistance with Portuguese residence permits for investment activity, known as ARI or the Golden Visa.
keywords: Legal assessment of investment eligibility Preparation of personal and investment documents Application preparation and follow-up Biometric appointments Renewals and continuing requirements Coordination with family and company matters

title: Family Reunification
description: Assistance with family residence in Portugal and the documents needed to support an application.
keywords: Assessment of the applicable family requirements Evidence of family relationships Residence and accommodation documents Foreign certificates, translations and legalisation Children and parental consent Coordination with the principal residence application
